simple.meaning: חַמּוֹן (Chammôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chammon , the name of two places in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַמּוֹן (H2540) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 19:28, with occurrences in Joshua, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַמּוֹן (H2540) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חַמּוֹן (H2540) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חַמּוֹן (Chammôwn) / H2540 is traced through Joshua 19:28, 1 Chronicles 6:61 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
